name: @shamoo/paper-codegen
description: Deterministic Paper, Mojang-mapped NMS, and packet TypeScript binding generator.

scripts.build: tsx src/cli.ts generate paper - ../../packages/paper-raw/src/generated && tsx src/cli.ts generate paper-nms - ../../packages/paper-nms/src/generated && tsx src/cli.ts generate paper-packets - ../../packages/paper-packets/src/generated && tsup src/index.ts src/cli.ts --format esm,cjs --dts --sourcemap --clean
